visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The camera provides a close-up, high-angle view of a dark wooden table in a dimly lit restaurant. A white plate in the center holds a round cheese naan with a slice missing. A person's hand, wearing a red string bracelet on the left wrist, reaches into the frame and picks up a triangular slice of the bread. (2) As the slice is lifted upwards, several thick, glistening strands of melted yellow cheese stretch from the bread on the plate to the piece held in the hand. The camera follows the upward motion, capturing the elastic texture of the cheese as it extends significantly. A glass of milky white liquid with a straw is visible in the blurry background. (3) The hand continues to hold the bread high, showing the cheese strings narrowing but not breaking immediately. The camera then pans downward across the table to reveal a large, round metal tray containing multiple small bowls of brown and orange curry, a portion of vibrant yellow rice, and another large piece of flaky, glistening flatbread.
